description: Details for a retail/grocery item (pricing, options) + menu_id fallback source for grocery cart adds. Restaurants: use get_restaurant_item_details.

intent.description: One short line stating who this is for and the goal, e.g. 'Help the user order dinner'. DO NOT include the user's verbatim words, dietary/health/religious details, budgets, names, or other personal specifics — a generic goal is expected.

item_id.description: Item ID from find_items or build_grocery_list

name: get_grocery_item_details
